channel.title: Crypto Record
channel.description: Crypto Record reports news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, regulation and network upgrades across the crypto market.

item.title: Withdrawing crypto from a Layer 2: how to reach Ethereum
item.description: How to withdraw crypto from a Layer 2 to Ethereum: use a supported bridge, review fees and timing, then finalize any claim and verify the recipient’s balance on Ethereum.

item.title: My DeFi swaps and staking rewards: when tax is due
item.description: How are my DeFi swaps and staking rewards taxed? Swaps can trigger capital gains or losses; staking rewards are usually income at their market value when received.

item.title: After Acceptance, a Matcha Auto Swap Still Needs Settlement
item.description: What happens after a solver accepts a Matcha Auto swap? The solver arranges execution, and tokens arrive only after the onchain transaction settles successfully.

item.title: Which wallet should I use for Gnosis Chain tokens? Start with MetaMask
item.description: Which crypto wallet for Gnosis Chain tokens? MetaMask is the easiest start; compare Rabby’s DeFi previews and Ledger’s hardware signing before connecting.

item.title: Intent Auctions Decide Who Fills Your Swap and at What Price
item.description: How do solvers compete to fill my intent-based order? They bid under auction rules to execute your signed minimum, shaping both the price you receive and when it fills.

item.title: What Is Shared Security in Blockchain? A Restaking Example
item.description: What is shared security in blockchain? It lets an additional service use stakers’ and operators’ economic backing, while restaking brings rewards and slashing risk.

item.title: US wins authority to seize $1.2bn in Binance hack funds
item.description: US courts authorized seizure or restraint of over $1.2 billion in funds stolen from Binance, while investigators and crypto firms keep tracing and freezing assets.

item.title: How do you use Revoke.cash to revoke on Base?
item.description: How to use revokecash on Base: match the token and spender, sign a revocation with the owning wallet, then confirm the permission is inactive on-chain.

item.title: US wins authority over $1.2bn in stolen Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department secured authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion in Binance theft proceeds, part of $2.7 billion frozen so far.

item.title: Do I need Chainlist to add a network? Choose the right route
item.description: Do I need Chainlist to add a network? No: try your wallet’s network list or a dApp prompt first, and verify the chain ID if you add it yourself.

item.title: How Restaking Operators Choose AVSs to Support: The Trade-Offs
item.description: How do restaking operators choose which AVSs to support? They weigh service demands, slashing exposure and operating costs against their capacity and risk limits.

item.title: US wins authority over $1.2B in Binance hack funds
item.description: The Justice Department says courts authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion from Binance’s $6 billion hack, while tracing and freezes continue.

item.title: US wins court authority over $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department won court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of stolen Binance crypto, while tracing and recovery efforts continue.

item.title: Zcash holders to vote on moving 50,000 ZEC from grants fund
item.description: Zcash holders and community panels will vote Nov. 16–30 on moving 50,000 ZEC into a mining reserve, while ending the grants program’s automatic 8% issuance share.

item.title: Visa adds Monad as a stablecoin settlement option
item.description: Visa has added Monad for participating issuers and acquirers to settle obligations in stablecoins, adding another blockchain rail to its growing program.

item.title: Coinbase’s national trust charter takes effect under OCC oversight
item.description: Coinbase says the OCC finalized its trust charter, placing planned institutional crypto custody under federal oversight while keeping the entity outside deposit banking.
